to_json(t).title: A continuing responsibility
to_json(t).body: Ongoing ownership of the website inside an enterprise marketing team: Webflow and CMS across launches and campaigns, analytics that get trusted before spend, consent that behaves, schema the engines parse.
to_json(t).chain: problem: no owner across seams → move: single-operator coverage → result: site holds shape between teams → limits: numbers shared on request
to_json(t).attribution: sole operator: platform, analytics, consent, schema

to_json(t).title: A campaign, in context
to_json(t).body: Campaign pages for a contract-management business where measurement kept breaking at the edges: consent discipline and embed QA so the data survives the campaign.
to_json(t).chain: problem: measurement broke at the edges → move: consent + embed discipline → result: clean data survives campaigns → limits: baseline pre-dates tooling
to_json(t).attribution: sole operator: consent architecture, tracking QA

to_json(t).title: A portfolio with a common structure
to_json(t).body: A property portfolio of one-off pages rebuilt as a single publishing system: shared CMS architecture with schema and answer-shaped content that search and AI engines parse.
to_json(t).chain: problem: one-off pages decayed → move: CMS as system + schema @graph → result: machine-quotable structure → limits: quoted volume still accruing
to_json(t).attribution: sole operator: CMS architecture, schema design
